_meta.purpose: Which barcodes identify a retail consumer pack (D-103). /scan and /review refuse the rest before anything is read.
_meta.source: GS1 General Specifications Standard, Release 26.0, Ratified, Jan 2026 (ref.gs1.org/standards/genspecs): Table 1-4 Synopsis of GS1 Prefix ranges; Table 1-5 Synopsis of GS1-8 Prefixes; Table 1-6 Synopsis of U.P.C. Prefix ranges; section 2.1 Table 2-17 (GTIN-14 indicator digits 1-8 are trade item groupings, 9 is variable measure); retail consumer trade items carry a GTIN-13, GTIN-12 or GTIN-8.
_meta.how: A 12-digit UPC-A is read as a GTIN-13 with a leading 0 (GS1 Prefix = 0 + the U.P.C. prefix). A GTIN-14 with indicator 0 is the GTIN-13 inside it. Prefixes are matched longest first.
_meta.not_refused_on_purpose: GS1 Prefix 05 (Table 1-4: used for GS1 Company Prefixes; Table 1-6 marks U.P.C. prefix 5 reserved) is allowed: refusing a real pack is worse than letting one odd code through to a 'not in catalogue' answer.

_notes.gtin13_prefixes.not_a_product: 0000001-0000099 unused (collision with GTIN-8); 951 former EPC GID numbers; 952 demonstrations and examples; 977 ISSN (serials); 978-979 ISBN/ISMN (books, music); 980 refund receipts; 981-983 and 99 coupons; 984-989 reserved.
_notes.gtin8_prefixes.store_code: 000-099 and 200-299: Restricted Circulation Numbers within a company.
